parole.testo: There are a number of theories about the origin of this term: * Borrowed from German Freier (“suitor, bachelor; customer of prostitutes”) via Yiddish [Term?], from frei (“free”). First used by prostitutes in Odessa's criminal world to refer to their clients. * Borrowed from German Freiherr (“baron”)
